sloka: रक्षसा तेन बाणौघैर्निकृत्ता सा सहस्रधा।निपपात शिला भूमौ गृध्रचक्रमिवाकुलम् ।। ६.९८.१४ ।।
transliteration: rakṣasā tena bāṇaughairnikṛttā sā sahasradhā।nipapāta śilā bhūmau gṛdhracakramivākulam ।। 6.98.14 ।।

translations.english: That rock, struck by Mahodara fell on the ground shattered and broken into a thousand pieces.
